name: IPW-XFWL E-Championship
epitaph: Defended through the fall of 2003, the belt changed hands at Hardcore Holiday when Bouncer pinned the champion in a three-way Triangle Turbulence match with its own unusual pinning rules.

name: IPW-XFWL Junior Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice in the record that survives: Bouncer lost it to Mark Prohibition in mid-2003, and Mark lost it to Venom in the deciding fall of a two-out-of-three-falls match at Hardcore Holiday.

name: IPW-XFWL Women's Championship
epitaph: Mistress Of Light held the belt into the fall of 2003 before Peaches won it at an untelevised event; Amanda Clark then won it from Peaches in a ladder match at Hardcore Holiday.

name: IPW-XFWL Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Future's reign ended not in the ring but in an office: after their chain match against The Russians at Hardcore Holiday drew two referees to two different pinfall calls, the promotion's own authority figure declared the title vacant and promised a tournament in January.

name: IPW-XFWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Tyrant's reign ended at Hardcore Holiday, pinned by 411 in a triple-threat Bring Your Own Weapon match against JuggaØ, a former owner of the promotion's own predecessor.
